rationale: This hardens task-scope provenance at the existing Goal Execution and Agent Workload admission/validation boundaries. It does not add or change a runner, provider, device/resource allocation, host service, Current Host proof recipe, hardware behavior, execution authority, or promotion claim. Executable workloads now fail closed when task scope provenance is missing or open-ended; the native/current-host execution mechanism is unchanged. Therefore no fresh physical Current Host requalification is required.
